name: Type 075 (Yushen) landing helicopter dock, Hainan class (drawn off Hainan LHD-31 and Anhui LHD-33)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'Type 075 landing helicopter dock' (raw wikitext read 2026-11-12): length 232 m, beam 36.8 m (MSA notice), flight deck 226 x 36 m

boxiness_max.reason: flat-deck LHD: the 226 x 36 m flight deck, a real 85 x 20 m well cavity (floor, deckhead and walls; the wellgate contract, seen whenever the gate swings open) and a flat transom are 35% of the area; the hull is lofted (about 59% without the well). Accepted by the lead, batch 3.

references.name: [A2] Anhui (LHD-33) 2025-05-16, starboard broadside
references.note: Nearly level starboard broadside from the air: stern x 190, deck front x 1548 (232.1 m at 5.85 px/m), waterline row 386, X = -116 + (px - 190) / 5.85. The photograph is soft (5.85 px/m, 2-3 px blur = 0.4-0.5 m) and the grey ship differs from the blue sea by only 5-15 in blue-minus-red, so its mask is unreliable: kept as an advisory outline and the source of the landmarks, read by column scans of blue-minus-red at half contrast. The camera is a little above the deck, so the flight deck's far side shows over the near deck edge aft of the island.

references.name: [A1] Anhui (LHD-33), straight down at sea
references.note: Overhead, bow right, island on the lower (starboard) edge, so it is already port-up. Stern corners x 245, bow x 1360: 4.81 px/m on the 232 m; deck rows 375..555 = 37.4 m across (deck centre row 465). The deck outline and its stern notches, the six spots to port and the seventh aft of the island, the lineup lines running from the port edge across each spot to the dashed line (Y -5.2), the stern and forward lifts, the island strip x 600..950 (X -42..+31). Helicopters, deck tractors and the wake are on the picture: advisory only.

references.name: [H1] Hainan (LHD-31), starboard bow
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'PLANS Hainan (LHD-31) starboard bow view.jpg'
references.note: For the reviewer: the square deck front over the deep fascia, the bow flaring hard in to a raked stem, the anchor high on the flare, the island's towers, the bridge with its window band, the deck-edge crane with two rows of raft canisters under it, the guard rail along the deck edge, balconies and doors in the topsides.

references.name: [H3] Hainan (LHD-31), starboard quarter
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'PLANS Hainan (LHD-31) starboard aft view.jpg'
references.note: For the reviewer: the flat transom, the ribbed well gate in two rows of panels with a dark slot over it, the big recess under the flight deck with a balcony rail, the corner platforms (HHQ-10 box to port, CIWS to starboard), scuttles in the transom, the guard rail round the stern and quarters of the flight deck.

must_show: flat flight deck x -112.9..+116, 36 m wide (y -18..+18), square at the bow with small chamfers (x 114.8..116) and two notches at the stern corners (port x -112.9..-107.6, y 15.1..18; starboard x -112.9..-109.4, y -18..-7.4); deck at z 19.6

seven spots painted on the deck: six to port at y +9.9 (x 96.7, 59.5, 23.1, -13.3, -50.5, -88.1) and one aft of the island at x -74.7, y -10.4; each lineup line from the port edge across the spot to the dashed line at y -5.2

starboard island x -42..+29 on the deck edge (y -17.9..-8.0): low deckhouse (roof 24.8), after tower x -38..-23 (30.6) with two domes and a lattice mast at x -25, glazed block x -14.3..+1.4 (32.3) with two rows of windows, forward tower x 4.5..14.5 (36.9) with the tapered mast to 45 and the planar array at about 49.6, the bridge x 14..22.8 with its glazing band at z 31..32.6, the forward block x 22.5..29 (26.0) with an HHQ-10 box

deep fascia from z 15.2 to the deck over a bow that flares hard in to a raked stem (stem at the waterline about x 103, meeting the fascia's underside at x 110), anchors in pockets high on the flare at x 100.2, z 8.2 (the dark pocket on [A2] at X 98.3..102)

the stern: flat transom at x -112.9 with the 20 m well gate (y -10..+10, z 0.2..8.0, two rows of ribbed panels) in the group 'wellgate', a dark slot over it, the dark recess under the flight deck (y -6.6..+12, z 15.6..19) with a balcony rail
the corner platforms below the deck at the stern (z 17.1): the HHQ-10 box to port at y +13.4, the 11-barrel CIWS to starboard at y -13.4, both at x -112
the deck-edge crane forward of the island (x 31..40, y -20.6..-17.9) with ten raft canisters in two rows under it (x 32..38.4, z 15.6..17.1)

balconies on the topsides at x -92, -69.8, -56, -28.8, -10, 15.6, 53.2, 70 (z 14.4..15.4), the vehicle-deck side door at x -8.5..+0.5, z 6.2..11.8, rows of small windows at z 16.6 and 13, scuttles at z 4.6
the guard rail round the flight-deck edge (posts and two wires, 1 m) except along the island, x -112.9..+116
plain PLAN light grey, red anti-fouling below z -0.6, a dark boot top, dark grey non-skid deck; no hull number, spot numbers or flag

the port side: no port photograph; its balconies and side door mirror the starboard ones
the two boats on the port sponsons (boat-shaped objects on [A1], identity not seen) and the forward CIWS on the port sponson (the only remaining mount on [A1])
